method: Literal published EPSG:4326 service GeoJSON shell, copied with every coordinate, vertex order and closing repeat unchanged. Original EPSG:3857 JSON is archived and independently reprojected vertexwise to verify equivalence. Classified ESTIMATED because source placement/current extent and lineage remain unresolved; coarse source outlines disagree with the frozen OSM baseline. No new coordinate estimate, datum reinterpretation, fitted shift, correction, snapping, clipping, simplification, buffering, repair, densification or invented edge. Exact current OSM place points corroborate names only and are never fit controls.
license: Public ArcGIS source geometry reuse rights unestablished; ODbL-1.0 for archived actual OSM name-point identity evidence.
uncertainties: Original boundary survey/reference period, whole current quarter extent, absolute boundary accuracy, source lineage and reuse rights are unknown. Across25same-name source/baseline pairs the published source centroids are all west of the unreviewed OSM baseline (median source-minus-baseline −61.063mE,−27.218mN); cause and which dataset is more accurate are unestablished. This relative diagnostic is not an accuracy bound. Source coordinates are preserved without correction. Native/service reprojection fidelity does not establish ground accuracy.
Six names are independently corroborated by actual current OSM source points. Complete current boundaries and official/legal quarter status are not thereby established.
rightsStatus: Original boundary lineage and unrestricted reuse licence unknown. Public access is not a licence. University organization/search-source label is not proof of publisher lineage.
